sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:173919 Court No. - 73 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 34323 of 2024 Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar And 3 Others Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Jalaj Kumar Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard Mr. Jalaj Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicants and Ms. Kirti Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants to quash the charge sheet dated 17.04.2019 as well as cognizance order dated 16.07.2019 and the entire proceeding of Case No.1791 of 2019, (State of UP Vs. Akhilesh Kumar and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.146 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Subhash Nagar, District-Bareilly, pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-VII, Bareilly, on the basis of compromise.
Akhilesh Kumar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2024

entities.text: Case No.1791 of 2019, (State of UP Vs. Akhilesh Kumar and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the informant has moved an application before the Court concerned mentioning therein that FIR has been lodged under some misconception as his daughter was not harassed for additional dowry demand nor any dowry demand was raised by the applicant but no appropriate orders have been passed by the Court concerned till date.
Therefore, a direction may be issued to the Court concerned to decide the same within stipulated period.
Learned A.G.A. submits that he has no objection in case a direction is issued to the Court concerned to decide the matter within stipulated period.

In view of the above facts and circumstances of the case and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to pass appropriate orders on the aforesaid application of the informant, so filed, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
For the period of one month or till decision on the application moved by the informant, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 Rahul.
